Rockets need a hug too!

Starship becoming fully reusable is our ticket to Kardashev civilization.

Video

Everyone obsesses over Starship's height and thrust.

The number that actually matters: cost per kg to orbit.

Falcon 9 brought it from ~$54,500 (Shuttle era) to ~$1,500. Starship targets <$100.

A 500x reduction in 25 years. That's the curve enabling Mars, lunar bases and orbital industry. Everything else is a consequence of that one number.

Elon Musk: “It is impossible to become a multiplanet civilization without reusable rockets, just as it would have been impossible to colonize America with expendable boats."

BREAKING: Alaska and Hawaiian Airlines have expanded Starlink Wi-Fi to approximately 150 aircraft.

Alaska's entire regional Embraer 175 fleet is now equipped with Starlink and the first 50 mainline aircraft have completed installation.

Passengers can access free Starlink Wi-Fi through Atmos Rewards, with the broader rollout beginning in mid-July.

The expansion continues this fall with Starlink arriving on 787-9 Dreamliners, while the remaining mainline fleet is expected to be completed by 2027.

With speeds reaching up to 500 Mbps, Starlink delivers at least 7x faster performance than traditional inflight Wi-Fi.
